_note: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Shadowfetch palette (ADR-0009).
Defect this file exists for: ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT.md:246 counted five copies
of the palette with three different reds and greens, one of which
(shadowfetch-fireproof) renders INSIDE the Control Center window with a
different red from the window around it.
5.0.0: ONE look, ShadowCode -- gold / brushed dark steel on near-black.
The 3.1-4.1 Fire and Ice pair is gone: Fire's Umbra gold evolved into the
brighter ShadowCode gold, and every Ice asset (ShadowfetchIce, Glacier,
org.shadowfetch.ice, UmbraIce) was removed. Upgraded desktops are moved
off removed assets by /usr/lib/shadowfetch/look-migrate.sh.
Two rules govern every value below and the drift gate enforces both:
1. BRAND roles (accent, accent_bright, accent_deep, silver) live in the
single element 'shadowcode'. The gold is sampled from the ShadowCode
emblem's lit faces and wordmark (#EEB43C..#F4BF48); silver is the
'CODE' half of the wordmark (#BCBFC5), for secondary accents.
2. SEMANTIC roles (negative, warning, positive, link) are ELEMENT-
INVARIANT and must stay distinct from the accent. 5.0.0 moved warning
from #E0A33A to #E68F2E (and warning_dim with it): the old amber sat
CIEDE2000 4.6 from the new gold, the new one sits 11.6 from it and
29.4 from negative, and still reads 7.5:1 on the window colour.
Three SURFACES are recorded, not one. They genuinely differ and the
difference is deliberate; collapsing them would be a re-skin, not a dedup.
Each copy must match ITS surface exactly -- that is what the gate checks.
WCAG contrast (checked when these values were chosen):
desktop text #D6DBE1 on window 13.6:1, on ink 14.0:1
accent #F2B33D on window 10.2:1, on ink 10.5:1; ink on accent 10.5:1
accent_deep #B97E22 on window 5.5:1; silver #BCC0C6 on window 10.4:1
app-chrome text on bg 15.6:1; gold on bg 9.7:1, on card 8.6:1
document text on bg 15.9:1; gold on bg 10.4:1, on card 9.5:1
